name: cool-redhead-skater-girl-street-photography
image_purpose: Create a vertical street-fashion social portrait with skate culture styling.

prompt.main_subject: One original adult woman with long straight auburn-red hair and blunt bangs, fair complexion, sharp winged eyeliner, matte red lipstick and a cool relaxed gaze. She wears a black graphic crop top with secure coverage over a black fishnet mesh long-sleeve top, khaki-green cargo jogger pants with elastic cuffs, black-and-white high-top canvas sneakers and a silver chain choker. Do not use a celebrity or public-figure likeness.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body to medium vertical 9:16 low-angle street photograph. The subject sits on asphalt leaning back against a concrete utility pole, one leg extended toward the camera with foreshortening and the other knee bent. She holds a skateboard vertically by the nose, deck facing forward with pink-and-yellow graffiti-style art and yellow wheels. Include yellow road markings, a pole with yellow chevron hazard stripes, blurred trees, blue sky with white clouds and distant urban buildings.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural daytime light with soft shadows and even illumination; detailed fabric, weathered concrete and scratched skateboard textures; cool alternative street atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Ultra-realistic HDR/UHD street photography, 8K look, high depth of field, sharp subject focus, slight background bokeh, detailed fishnet and cotton texture, vertical 9:16.
